title: Concrete Existence of Distinct Totient Runs

problemStatement.formal: exists_distinct_totient_run_all_K : ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ, IsDistinctTotientRun n K
problemStatement.plain: For every K, there exists n such that φ(n+1), φ(n+2), ..., φ(n+K) are all distinct. Explicit witnesses are provided for K = 3, 5, 7, 9, 10.
whyMatters: Shows the EPS87 upper bound K ≤ n/exp(c(log n)^{1/3}) is non-vacuous: runs do exist
Provides concrete computational evidence for Erdős #1004 conjecture
The K=10 witness (n=45) demonstrates the phenomenon for moderately large runs

proven: exists_distinct_totient_run_all_K: ∀ K, ∃ n, IsDistinctTotientRun n K
open: Erdős #1004 main conjecture: ∀ c > 0, ∀ᶠ x, ∃ n ≤ x, IsDistinctTotientRun n ⌊(log x)^c⌋

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE: Proved universal existence of distinct totient runs and 5 concrete witnesses.
